items.docs: Retrieve the list of billing accounts associated with your organization. Your organization will have one billing account per supported currency.

params.name: cursor
params.description: An opaque string that lets you view a consistent list of transactions.

params.name: start
params.description: Filter transactions created at or after this time. Time is in RFC 3339 format. Example: 2024-11-18T00:00:00Z

params.name: end
params.description: Filter transactions created before this time. Time is in RFC 3339 format. Example: 2024-11-18T00:00:00Z

params.name: time_field
params.description: Time field to filter by. Accepted values are created_date, modified_date, and attribution_date. When not specified, created_date is used as default.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of transaction to retrieve in each request. When not specified, 50 is used as default.

params.name: country
params.description: Filter transactions by country. Country is in ISO 3166 Alpha-2 format (case-insensitive). Example: US

items.docs: Retrieve a list of transactions within a single billing account (single currency).
